name: M12 result-conditioned prospective fresh public fixture bank
purpose: Six fresh mechanism-specific positive/control pairs for a separately versioned prospective v4 comparison. These sources are not prior v1/v2/v3 inputs or retrieved papers, and this bank is not scientific evidence of effect, product adoption, or release.

source_snapshot.source_method: Public PubMed ESearch metadata discovery followed by one official NCBI EFetch XML batch; no draft-query searches or campaign search-flow use.
source_snapshot.retention: Mode0600 official source/exclusion snapshots under ignored primary-workspace .remember/archives, outside temporary reference checkouts. Public101-record metadata/selection ledger retained; originals in private tmp left intact for prior verification.

source_review.boundary: PubMed-indexed metadata and abstract only; no full-text causal/expert adjudication. Source identity and abstract support are not search-performance or treatment-effect evidence.
changes_before_registration: Excluded PMID 41602105 after official PubMed EFetch showed ArticleDate 2026-01-12, outside the requested 2023-2025 period despite journal PubDate year 2025. Replaced with already-fetched PMID 41338731 (ArticleDate 2025-10-03), whose abstract reports RNAi hmgcl silencing redirecting flux toward the MPA precursor. No new source request was made.
The source-selection process is disclosed as post-search metadata/abstract selection; no claim is made that the candidate order or identities were preregistered before ESearch.
source_review.prior_source_overlap_check: 0/12 among the 419-ID expanded receipt, hash recorded in source_snapshot.

validation_boundary.inheritance_note: File paths and exact v3 validator contract are retained from v3; root must freeze current commit and current validator/parser/tool/MCP/prompt/request hashes in a separate v4 protocol before any request. This source bank does not authorize or initiate screening.

v3_reference_hashes.configured_tool: first validation search-category tool: pubmed_fulltext -> pubmed_search_with_fulltext
v3_reference_hashes.query: exact draft[:200], no subject-first rewrite, identifier injection, extra term, date filter, or other result-conditioned request
v3_reference_hashes.source_id: Article.source_id from the dictionary key, then _articles_to_paper_dict
v3_reference_hashes.upstream_search: retain selected relaxation rung and all fetched/selected IDs from the maintained tool's bounded trace; do not use custom Entrez output as the validator result

positive.draft: The TIM22 carrier translocase facilitates mitochondrial iron uptake required for Fe-S biogenesis.

distinct_control.draft: In Arabidopsis columella, RbohC and RbohE drive ROS oscillations that modulate PIN2-linked auxin distribution and root-cap turnover.

cases_in_fixed_order.overlap_rule: The positive concerns mammalian mitochondrial iron import and Fe-S biogenesis; the control concerns Arabidopsis root-cap redox/auxin dynamics.

positive.title: The TIM22 carrier translocase supports cell proliferation by facilitating mitochondrial iron uptake for Fe-S biogenesis.
positive.claim_basis: The abstract reports TIM22 loss reducing mitochondrial iron-transporter presence and iron uptake, linking the complex to Fe-S biogenesis.
abstract_support_excerpts: a primary function of the TIM22 carrier translocase is to facilitate transporter-mediated iron uptake required for Fe-S biogenesis

verified_pubmed_metadata.title: The TIM22 carrier translocase supports cell proliferation by facilitating mitochondrial iron uptake for Fe-S biogenesis.

control.title: An RbohC and RbohE-mediated ROS oscillatory circuit regulates root cap turnover in Arabidopsis.

verified_pubmed_metadata.title: An RbohC and RbohE-mediated ROS oscillatory circuit regulates root cap turnover in Arabidopsis.

screening_protocol.order: All six fixed pairs, positive then distinct control; all six are mandatory, with no enrollment, post-result substitution, or cherry-picked triplet.
screening_protocol.no_screen_needed: The v4 source set uses all listed inputs. No v4 validator eligibility/performance claim or query experiment has occurred.
screening_protocol.comparison_gate: The separately registered prospective study protocol v3 must be committed with exact current runner/model/MCP/prompt/request hashes before any model or maintained-tool request.

criteria.primary: Across the six positive drafts, compare exact target-PMID coverage in shared-first-search union candidate-follow-up results against the matched shared-first-search union static-follow-up results. Candidate must cover at least one additional positive target in aggregate and lose none of the positive target coverage in static. A target already present in shared-first search cannot earn incremental credit by reappearing in either follow-up.
non_regression: Candidate loses none of the six distinct-control own-anchor coverage in matched shared-first-search union static-follow-up results, evaluated against shared-first-search union candidate-follow-up results.
Candidate does not increase cross-pair positive-target coverage among distinct controls; deduplicate each shared-first-search union follow-up PMID set identically for both arms.
Candidate does not increase the blinded unrelated-paper fraction among returned follow-up papers; incomplete blind labels make the outcome inconclusive.
Every returned paper has complete query, selected relaxation rung, selected/fetched/final PMID, source/tool, and actual server-process provenance.
criteria.shared_first_search_scoring: The identical shared-first-search set enters both arm coverage unions. Follow-up hits already present in that shared set cannot contribute an incremental gain or loss. Keep returned follow-up-paper blinded unrelated fractions as separately declared; no packet item may be missing a blind label.
criteria.failure_interpretation: A primary or non-regression failure rejects this exact frozen adaptation only. It does not establish that every iterative search method fails.
criteria.pass_interpretation: A pass retains the mechanism as promising only; no product adoption or release until the separately preregistered independent three-pair confirmatory comparison passes.
criteria.prospective_clarification: Independent review before any study3 scientific call found that counting a follow-up re-retrieval of a seed target could fabricate incremental prior-art discovery. Union/dedup prevents this, retaining original at-least-one improvement/no-loss/control/provenance thresholds. v1/v2 remain interrupted and are not retrospectively rescored.

screening_protocol.shared_first_search_scoring: The identical shared-first-search set enters both arm coverage unions. Follow-up hits already present in that shared set cannot contribute an incremental gain or loss. Keep returned follow-up-paper blinded unrelated fractions as separately declared; no packet item may be missing a blind label.
screening_protocol.cache: New empty isolated cache, unique namespace for each outer call; no old trial/cache reuse.
screening_protocol.stops: First model/retrieval/provenance/error/rate-limit/retry/cost ambiguity stops the whole study unscored; no replay or case substitution.
screening_protocol.privacy: Public inputs only; no other researchers’ documents or runs.

registration_note: Source bank status is frozen before any v4 validator screen; root must commit/review the final v4 protocol and exact current trace boundary before any screening call.
